cases.name: Linda Delaine Welch Robinson
cases.about:
"She’d give you the shirt off her back if you needed it," said her daughter, Angela Robinson, "I watched her take the last five dollars out of her pocket two weeks ago to give it to a charity because they needed it.” 

https://www.wcnc.com/article/news/crime/woman-found-dead-chester-south-carolina-investigation/275-2b779647-a763-4493-8987-58832ce699bb
cases.narrative: On 8/2/2021, her body was found along the side of the road in an area on Carpenter Road off Highway 72. She had trauma inflicted to her head and face.
